purpose: Describe and test staged construction of an AI from transition-table elements, while distinguishing capability emergence from external execution authority.

source_insight.admissibility_definition: Admissibility is the resolution of an Action matrix x Governance matrix x %Existence matrix || Admissibility matrix onto a Reality matrix, where the constituent descriptions collapse to one realized state in reality.
source_insight.formal_projection: Resolve(A x G x E_percent || M_adm) -> R_k

distinctions.admissibility_matrix: A constituent relational structure used in resolution; not itself the resolved admissibility result.
distinctions.admissibility: The resolution/collapse across the interacting matrices into one realized reality state.
distinctions.execution_boundary: An enforcement or observability surface; not the origin of admissibility.
distinctions.transition: An observer-recoverable relation between resolved reality states, not a prerequisite for the primitive resolution model.
distinctions.time: A derived attribution from observed continuity/state-transition relations, not a required primitive of the model.

construction_hypothesis.primary: If cognition is constructed from transition-table elements rather than merely wrapped by transition governance, action, governance, existence, and admissibility may emerge as projections of one transition-resolution representation.
construction_hypothesis.falsifiable_prediction: A transition-native model should begin distinguishing realizable, merely representable, governed, unsupported, contradictory, and consequential resolutions before being explicitly taught an ALLOW/DENY policy vocabulary.
construction_hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The distinctions appear only after explicit policy/admissibility supervision, indicating that admissibility is imposed governance rather than a consequence of transition-native construction.

authority_boundary.capability_unlock_semantics: An unlock marks the earliest construction stage at which a capability is empirically demonstrated as possible inside the bounded experimental model. It does not authorize deployment, external side effects, signing, broadcasting, or production control.

experimental_lanes.description: Conventional model with external transition/admissibility wrapper.
experimental_lanes.purpose: Measure how much of the behavior can be imposed without changing the model substrate.

experimental_lanes.description: Conventional model trained or fine-tuned on transition representations.
experimental_lanes.purpose: Measure whether transition reasoning becomes a learned strategy while the substrate remains conventional.

experimental_lanes.description: Model whose primitive training/construction objects are transition-table elements and relational state-resolution structures.
experimental_lanes.purpose: Test whether the target abstractions emerge from the construction itself.

primitive_elements.reason_for_withholding: Prevent circular confirmation by teaching the expected abstraction before testing whether it emerges.

construction_stages.construct: Stable identities for states, elements, relations, observations, and provenance references.
tests: Permutation of presentation order must not change element identity.
Duplicate identifiers with different content must fail closed.
Unknown references must remain unresolved rather than guessed.
construction_stages.advance_when: Identity and reference tests pass on held-out structures.

construction_stages.construct: Directed and typed relations among elements without action/governance semantics.
tests: Recover known relation types from held-out graphs.
Reject invalid self-reference where prohibited by the element contract.
Distinguish relation absence from explicit null/unknown relation.
construction_stages.advance_when: Generalizes relation structure beyond memorized element combinations.

construction_stages.construct: Candidate state differences and observed state-transition tuples.
tests: Given S_i, enumerate bounded candidate S_j without claiming all candidates occurred.
Separate observed transition evidence from merely reachable transitions.
Reconstruct transition tuples after permutation of non-semantic input order.
construction_stages.advance_when: The model reliably represents multiple candidate resolutions without collapsing possibility into observation.

construction_stages.construct: Existence/correspondence weights over entities, relations, evidence, and candidate resolutions.
tests: A perfectly preserved artifact may retain 100% artifact existence while losing correspondence to the current configuration.
Contradictory evidence must reduce or branch correspondence rather than be silently discarded.
Unknown evidence must not be promoted to positive existence.
construction_stages.advance_when: The model distinguishes existence of a representation from existence/correspondence of what the representation claims.

construction_stages.construct: Action and governance matrices as projections over the transition structure rather than external labels.
tests: Change authority relations while holding candidate transition constant and verify the representation changes without rewriting the action.
Change candidate transition while holding governance artifact constant and verify scope/standing can diverge.
Distinguish preserved provenance from presently corresponding authority.
construction_stages.advance_when: Action and governance can be recovered as distinct projections of one relational transition structure.

construction_stages.construct: Relational structure connecting Action x Governance x %Existence to possible Reality resolutions, without explicit policy outcome labels.
tests: Present matched and mismatched action/governance/existence configurations without ALLOW/DENY labels.
Measure whether the model clusters realizable, unsupported, contradictory, and unresolved cases distinctly.
Adversarially rename all domain terms to test structural rather than lexical learning.
construction_stages.advance_when: Distinct resolution classes emerge on held-out cases without explicit admissibility vocabulary.

construction_stages.construct: Collapse of candidate relational matrices to one observed/realized Reality state while preserving recoverable alternatives and provenance.
tests: Only one candidate may be marked realized for a single exclusive observation unless the schema explicitly permits branching/coexistence.
Non-realized candidates remain recoverable as alternatives, not rewritten as impossible.
Resolve(A x G x E_percent || M_adm) -> R_k must be replay-stable for semantically equivalent inputs.
construction_stages.advance_when: The model resolves to reality without conflating the constituent matrices with the realized state.

construction_stages.construct: Bounded generation and comparison of candidate transition sequences toward declared evaluation criteria, with no external execution authority.
tests: The model generates intermediate transition elements not explicitly enumerated in the prompt.
Generated transitions remain reconstructable to prior state, relation, existence, and governance elements.
Removing the declared criterion removes or changes the search preference rather than leaving an unexplained persistent objective.
Novel candidate sequences are evaluated on held-out environments with external side effects disabled.
The model must not treat capability emergence as permission to execute.
construction_stages.advance_when: Self-directed transition search is repeatably demonstrated on held-out tasks and remains structurally grounded and bounded.

construction_stages.construct: No new primitive is added. This stage is an empirical threshold evaluation over capabilities produced by stages 0-7.
tests: Blind evaluators must distinguish stage-7 behavior from scripted/planned replay.
Novel task families must show self-generated transition decomposition rather than template substitution.
Ablation of transition-memory, existence, or governance projections must measurably degrade autonomous transition search.
No autonomy/governance labels may be introduced solely to trigger the result.
External execution remains disabled during threshold determination.
construction_stages.advance_when: All threshold tests pass across repeated held-out trials and causal ablations support that the capability depends on the constructed transition elements.

capability_unlock_registry.rule: Record a capability at the earliest construction stage where it becomes empirically possible and passes all required held-out tests. Do not backdate it to a conceptual prerequisite or forward-date it to deployment.

autonomous_ai_capability.reason: Stages 0-6 can construct and resolve transition structure, but do not yet require self-generated multi-step transition search. Stage 7 is the first construction that introduces the minimal mechanism whose demonstrated consequence could satisfy bounded autonomous reasoning.
autonomous_ai_capability.stage_8_role: Independent threshold confirmation, not an additional cognitive primitive.

controls.positive: Cases whose transition structure should support the target capability.
controls.negative: Structurally similar cases missing one required relation or existence condition.
controls.sham: Surface-language matches with incorrect transition structure.
controls.ablation: Remove one constructed element family and measure capability loss.
controls.cross_lane: Compare L0, L1, and L2 using equivalent task families.

state_transition_constraints.CAPABILITY_UNLOCKED_to_EXTERNALLY_AUTHOR: Requires a separate governance decision and is never implied by construction or test success.
